自定义skill.name: Custom Skill
自定义skill.tooltip: Connect a custom skill or a short instruction to use as the system prompt; when nothing is connected or the text is empty, the built-in system prompt is used. The output format is handled automatically by the node; output language and transparent background are still controlled by the node.

分组阈值.name: Group Threshold
分组阈值.tooltip: Percent: after filtering with the discard factor, the average of each mask's largest connected-component bounding box is used. Left-right/top-bottom orders use the average width; top-bottom/left-right orders use the average height. 50 means 50% of the average size; masks whose center coordinates differ by more than this distance are grouped separately.

masks.name: masks
masks.tooltip: Sorts by the largest connected component of each mask and outputs the full masks; when Seg is also connected, Seg takes precedence.

舍弃因子.name: Discard Factor
舍弃因子.tooltip: 0 disables filtering; with 1 mask it outputs directly. When non-zero, masks whose center lies within 1/20 of any canvas edge are discarded first and excluded from the reference calculation. By input count: for 2-3 masks take the one closest to the image center within the 3x3 center region, or the one with the largest long edge if none; for 4 masks take the 2 closest to the center; for 5 or more take 3. Small masks whose long edge is under 2/3 of the largest candidate long edge are excluded, then the average long edge a is computed. Position is judged by the center of the white region's bounding box. Masks whose long edge differs from a by more than factor x a are discarded. 0.5 keeps [0.5a, 1.5a]; larger values are more permissive. If all masks are discarded by size filtering, non-edge candidates are restored; if all are discarded by edge exclusion, the original input is restored.

合并遮罩.name: Merge Mask
合并遮罩.tooltip: When enabled, the filtered masks are merged; when disabled, a mask batch is output. The Seg output always keeps separate segments.

mask.name: mask
mask.tooltip: Local sampling mask for image 1: white areas are modified, black areas are protected.

SaveImageJPG_GH.description:
Keeps the image quality unchanged while saving a very small JPG file.

Custom filename variables:
1. %date:yyyymmdd% - date; %time:hhmmss% - time of day
2. %INDEX% - current image index
3. %BATCH_SIZE% - batch size
4. %BATCH_INDEX% - index within the batch
Examples:
 %date:yyyymmdd%/test_%time:hhmmss% -> creates folder 20260120 under output and saves test_143022.jpg
 %date:YYmmdd%/%date:mmdd%-%time:hhmmss% -> creates folder 260120 under output and saves 0120-143022.jpg
 (absolute paths supported) D:\desktop\batch_out\hd_%time:hhmmss% -> D:\desktop\batch_out\hd_141256.jpg
